headline: Chief Supervisor | Automation & Electronics Engineer
about:
I am a Mechatronics Engineering professional with extensive experience in industrial automation, electrical engineering, machine development, and electronic control system troubleshooting.

My expertise includes PLC programming, automation system development, machine prototyping, electrical troubleshooting, and component-level PCB repair. I have hands-on experience diagnosing and repairing electronic control boards, servo systems, and industrial machinery across the garment manufacturing industry.

I am passionate about developing practical engineering solutions, improving machine performance, and integrating automation technologies to support manufacturing efficiency and reliability.

My professional interests include Industrial Automation, Machine Development, Electronics Engineering, Industry 4.0, and IoT-based Monitoring Systems.
